blocked_sentences: Remove a +1/+1 counter from this creature: Add {C}{C}. Spend this mana only to activate abilities.

needs.what: An unrestricted spelling of the ACTIVATE half of an ability's `mana_restriction` -- "Spend this mana only to activate abilities", with no restriction whatsoever on the source of the ability. Concretely: a wildcard group (e.g. `"mana_restriction": {"activate": "any"}` or `{"activate": true}`) that the loader compiles to a RestrictionGroup satisfied by every SpendPurpose whose `kind` is ACTIVATE, and by no CAST purpose at all. The same shape then covers the sibling printings the queue already holds -- Omen Hawker's "{T}: Add {C}{U}. Spend this mana only to activate abilities." and Automated Artificer's "only to activate an ability or cast an artifact spell" (a wildcard activate half beside a named cast half).
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `mana_restriction` (ability_keys; src/automtg/cards/loader/mana.py:282) is the right field and already has the cast/activate split for Secluded Courtyard, but every group it can hold is a set of literal card type / subtype NAMES -- `RestrictionGroup.satisfied_by` (src/automtg/engine/mana.py:745) asks `required <= purpose.names and not (forbidden & purpose.names)`, where `purpose.names` is the types+subtypes of the source whose ability is being activated (`costs.ability_purpose`). There is no name that every source has, so no group can mean "any ability". `_restriction_groups` explicitly refuses an empty group ("restricts nothing; omit it for ordinary mana"), and the only non-literal leaf allowed is `{"chosen_type_of": "self"}`, which is this card's chosen subtype, not a wildcard. The two workarounds are both wrong in ways the brief forbids: omitting `mana_restriction` entirely makes plainly unrestricted mana that can also cast spells -- a strictly better card, which is exactly what the shipped Omen Hawker (data/cards/auto/templates.cards.json:65853) and Automated Artificer (:5255) approximations do today -- and a forbidden-only group built from an invented type word (`[[{"not": "nosuchtype"}]]`) smuggles a sentinel through a shape check whose own docstring warns that a name no card has freezes mana into something unspendable. The card's other two lines are expressible and were not written as a partial answer: "This creature enters with X +1/+1 counters on it" is the card-level `replacements` entry `{"event": "self_enters_with_counters", "counter": "+1/+1", "amount": {"x": true}}` (Goldvein Hydra prints the identical sentence), and "{1}, {T}: Put a +1/+1 counter on this creature" is an activated ability with `cost: {"mana": "{1}", "tap": true}` and `add_counters` on `self_only`.
